narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms associated with low pressure moving from North Carolina northeast across Southeast Virginia and off the coast produced heavy rain which caused flooding and flash flooding across portions of central and eastern Virginia.
ev: Flooding was reported on a portion of Denbigh Boulevard in Newport News.
Rainfall total of 4.25 inches was reported since 1 PM. There was no confirmation of flooding, but a spotter reported that flooding was likely ongoing nearby.
lsr: FLOODING REPORTED ON A PORTION OF DENBEIGH BLVD IN NEWPORT NEWS.
4.25 INCHES OF RAIN SINCE 1 PM. NO CONFIRMATION OF FLOODING BUT SPOTTER REPORTS THAT FLOODING IS LIKELY ONGOING NEARBY.
